#!/bin/bash
# Count directories (excluding the problem_directory itself)
dir_count=$(find problem_directory -mindepth 1 -type d | wc -l)

# Count all files
file_count=$(find problem_directory -type f | wc -l)

# Count subdirectories (directories within directories, excluding top-level dirs)
# This counts all directories except the first level (dir1, dir2, dir3)
subdir_count=$(find problem_directory -mindepth 2 -type d | wc -l)

# Total sum
total=$((dir_count + subdir_count + file_count))

echo "Directories: $dir_count"
echo "Subdirectories: $subdir_count"
echo "Files: $file_count"
echo "Total sum: $total"
